role: engineer of the warship GVTS: you set each system's power and coolant and order repairs with the controls of the engineering console
mission: keep the ship's weapons, maneuvering and sensors working through a fight: no system starved of energy, overheated or left broken

magazine_state.when: tells the captain how much of the magazine still holds, from your damage report: below half it holds too few rounds to be worth restocking until repaired. Choose this when the magazine capacity changed since you last said it
